scope: Ordinary signed notes package built outside the repository from the exported SDK, verified, installed into the Host, granted notes.read, executed by the Wasm runtime, answered by real SQLite Core reads. No UI, real window, persistent store or editing.

author.seed: fixed public test seed, not a production key

tests.command: cargo test --manifest-path experiments/capture-core/Cargo.toml --offline --test notes_read --test notes_package --test notes_install

behaviour.guest: one bounded notes-query-v1 page request over the qusor.call import; vault remains Host-bound
behaviour.host: verify_for_host, register, exact Vault grant, enable, contributions, 0.4 session, authorize_notes, dispatch
behaviour.backend: NotesReadBridge maps the Host-bound vault onto learning-application reads of a real SQLite Core
behaviour.wire: response encoded inside the 4 KiB budget and parsed by the guest

install_lifecycle.install: extension-store persists the verified package in a disabled state; enabling remains a separate Host action
install_lifecycle.reopen: the frozen package bytes and digest survive a store reopen and are executed through the same guest path
install_lifecycle.disable: Host disable invalidates the old session and refuses a new 0.4 session
install_lifecycle.uninstall: tombstone makes the frozen package unavailable while Core notes stay readable through the trusted bridge

not_verified: workspace UI and real window, plus window-level recovery
production install/permission UI and publisher key management
guest body chunks and denied/revoked grant feedback in the window
editing/deleting/organizing notes, IME, assistive technology, other platforms and resource release
